item.text: I’ll build a polished React app with clear overlap highlighting, separate desktop and mobile layouts, and saved preferences. I’ll configure it for port 9195 and verify the timezone calculations and running app.

item.text: I’m taking a calm, editorial direction: warm ivory, charcoal typography, and vivid lime for shared availability. The grid will stay precisely aligned, with fractional offsets preserved and each city’s current UTC offset shown alongside it.

Top-level `await` is available, along with a preconnected `browser` global and standard `console` output. A background daemon starts automatically when needed and manages browser instances, named pages, and CDP connections. Infinite loops will be interrupted. Returns the full path to the saved file. Example: const path = await saveScreenshot(await page.screenshot(), "home.png"); await writeFile(name: string, data: string): Promise Write data to ~/.dev-browser/tmp/. Returns the file content as a string. Example: const data = JSON.parse(await readFile("results.json")); console.log/info(...) Write output to stdout. console.warn/error(...) Write output to stderr. This holds for viewport and clip screenshots only — never derive click coordinates from a fullPage capture; scroll, then re-screenshot. A truncation marker line appears when the snapshot budget is hit. } Options: { track?: string, depth?: number, timeout?: number } page.getByRef(ref) Target an eN or iframe fNeN ref from snapshotForAI() page.getByRole(role, { name }) Target elements discovered from the snapshot page.textContent(selector) Get the text content of an element page.innerHTML(selector) Get the inner HTML of an element page.fill(selector, value) Fill an input field page.click(selector) Click an element page.type(selector, text) Type text character by character page.press(selector, key) Press a key such as Enter or Tab page.waitForSelector(selector) Wait for an element to appear page.waitForURL(url) Wait for navigation to a URL page.screenshot() Capture a screenshot buffer; save it with saveScreenshot(...) page.cua.screenshot(options) Save a JPEG for the vision workflow; returns { path, width, height } Options: { name?: string, fullPage?: boolean, clip? } page.cua.click({ x, y, waitForNavigation? }) Click at viewport coordinates; navigation wait defaults false page.domCua.getVisibleDom() Snapshot visible interactive elements as node_id=N lines page.domCua.click({ nodeId, waitForNavigation? Tips: - Use console.log(JSON.stringify(...)) for structured output. - Prefer page.snapshotForAI() for structure; use screenshots when visual layout or styling matters. - Keep page names stable across scripts so you can resume work after failures. - Each --browser name maps to a separate daemon-managed browser instance. - For unattended work, --idle-timeout 5m closes each idle daemon-launched browser while preserving its profile; it never closes --connect browsers. Use 0 to disable. - Use --connect to attach to an existing browser; omit the URL to auto-discover Chrome with debugging enabled. - Use short timeouts (--timeout 10) so scripts fail fast instead of hanging on missing elements. - Add --headless for unattended automation; omit it when you want to watch the browser window.

item.text: The app is implemented, including both comparison modes, searchable cities, reference switching, overnight schedules, and saved settings. Verification has hit an environment issue: package downloads cannot reach the registry, and Portly cannot launch. I’m checking the timezone logic independently while confirming which build checks can run.

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { awake, offset, localMinute, ranges, formatTime, cities } from './time.ts';
test('awake boundaries are start-inclusive and end-exclusive',()=>{assert.equal(awake(420,7,23),true);assert.equal(awake(1380,7,23),false);assert.equal(awake(419,7,23),false);});
test('overnight schedules cross midnight',()=>{assert.equal(awake(1380,22,6),true);assert.equal(awake(300,22,6),true);assert.equal(awake(360,22,6),false);assert.equal(awake(720,22,6),false);});
test('current-date offset calculation handles seasonal DST',()=>{assert.equal(offset('America/Los_Angeles',new Date('2026-07-01T12:00:00Z')),-420);assert.equal(offset('America/Los_Angeles',new Date('2026-01-01T12:00:00Z')),-480);});
test('fractional timezones keep all minutes',()=>{assert.equal(offset('Asia/Kolkata'),330);assert.equal(offset('Asia/Kathmandu'),345);assert.equal(localMinute(7,0,345),765);assert.equal(formatTime(765,'12h'),'12:45pm');assert.equal(formatTime(765,'24h'),'12:45');});
test('separate ranges remain separate and end at exclusive midnight',()=>{assert.deepEqual(ranges(Array.from({length:24},(_,h)=>h<2||h>=22)),[[0,2],[22,24]]);assert.deepEqual(ranges(Array(24).fill(false)),[]);});
test('default cities share exactly one summer hour and pairwise overlap differs',()=>{const zones=['America/Los_Angeles','Asia/Makassar','Europe/Zurich'];const off=zones.map(z=>offset(z,new Date('2026-09-30T12:00:00Z')));const availability=off.map(o=>Array.from({length:24},(_,h)=>awake(localMinute(h,off[0],o),7,23)));const all=Array.from({length:24},(_,h)=>availability.every(a=>a[h]));assert.deepEqual(ranges(all),[[7,8]]);const den=availability[0].map((a,h)=>a&&availability[1][h]);const gen=availability[0].map((a,h)=>a&&availability[2][h]);assert.notDeepEqual(den,gen);});
test('catalog has exactly 34 unique valid cities',()=>{assert.equal(cities.length,34);assert.equal(new Set(cities.map(c=>c.id)).size,34);for(const c of cities)assert.equal(Number.isFinite(offset(c.zone)),true);});
EOF
cat > README.md <<'EOF'
# GPT-6

A responsive timezone overlap checker built with React, TypeScript, and Vite.

## Run

"'```sh
pnpm install
pnpm dev
```

The app runs at http://localhost:9195. The port is fixed and strict.

## Checks

```sh
pnpm test
pnpm build
```

Tests use Node 22.6+ and cover DST, fractional timezone offsets, availability boundaries, overnight schedules, split windows, and default city overlap.

Meeting mode finds availability shared by every city. Base mode finds availability independently between each city and the first city; the reference row highlights the union of those pairwise windows. Click a city name to promote it to the reference position.

Preferences and the city list are saved locally. Equal wake and sleep hours mean 24-hour availability. Each column samples its start time; summary ranges describe qualifying one-hour slots, with their end exclusive. Fractional offsets remain visible in local cell labels. UTC offsets are derived from the current instant and refreshed each minute.
EOF
cat > .gitignore <<'"'EOF'
node_modules/
dist/
*.tsbuildinfo
.DS_Store
EOF
pnpm test
pnpm build"
